meta.title: Amputation & Prosthetic Rehabilitation | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Building strength, balance and confidence for life with a prosthesis.

overview: Life after amputation demands structured physical rehabilitation alongside significant emotional adjustment.

At Cambridge Hospital, we support patients from the early post-operative phase through stump conditioning, prosthetic fitting and training, gait relearning and adaptive techniques for daily living. Occupational therapists and physiotherapists work together from the first days post-amputation through to community reintegration, with home care services continuing support in the patient’s own environment.
